<issue>
fix(webui): preserve selected appearance theme across SPA navigation
## Summary

Selecting a theme in **Settings → Appearance** works initially and persists across a full page reload, but navigating to another page resets the UI to the theme captured at application startup.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open **Settings → Appearance**.
2. Change the theme from light to dark, or dark to light.
3. Navigate to another page using the sidebar.
4. Observe that the theme resets.

## Expected behavior

The selected theme should remain active across SPA navigation and continue to be persisted in localStorage.

## Missing coverage

The existing appearance-theme E2E test covers persistence across full page reloads but not client-side route navigation.

A regression test should:

1. Change the selected theme.
2. Navigate to another route through the SPA.
3. Verify that `data-theme` remains unchanged.
4. Verify that `localStorage["ironclaw:v2-theme"]` remains unchanged.

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find webui code that uses "ironclaw:v2-theme" or sets data-theme (grep excluding node_modules). Report file paths, line numbers and the relevant code snippets (full theme-related logic, including where theme is captured at startup and where navigation might reset it).

content.content: {"summary":"Theme persistence lives in the ironclaw:v2-theme localStorage key. The inline pre-paint script in index.html sets data-theme and window.__IRONCLAW_INITIAL_THEME__ at startup. The React hook useInterfaceTheme (design-system/theme.ts) reads that initial value, writes data-theme and localStorage on change, and is mounted in GatewayLayout. Nothing in the frontend source resets the theme on navigation. Only the e2e tests set data-theme directly. The built copy under target/ mirrors index.html and is not a source file.","findings":["crates/ironclaw_webui/frontend/index.html:29-36: startup IIFE reads localStorage 'ironclaw:v2-theme' (valid only if 'light'/'dark'), else falls back to prefers-color-scheme; sets document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme.","crates/ironclaw_webui/frontend/index.html:16-19 (in-script lines 15-16 of the snippet): sets window.__IRONCLAW_INITIAL_THEME__ = theme; catch branch (lines 18-19) forces 'light' on any exception.","crates/ironclaw_webui/frontend/src/design-system/theme.ts:3: THEME_STORAGE_KEY = \"ironclaw:v2-theme\".","crates/ironclaw_webui/frontend/src/design-system/theme.ts:7-20: getInitialTheme() priority: window.__IRONCLAW_INITIAL_THEME__ -> document.documentElement.dataset.theme -> localStorage -> matchMedia; catch returns 'light'.","crates/ironclaw_webui/frontend/src/design-system/theme.ts:22-43: useInterfaceTheme(); useState(getInitialTheme); useEffect([theme]) sets dataset.theme and localStorage; toggleTheme and setTheme update state only.","crates/ironclaw_webui/frontend/src/design-system/theme.ts:26: document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme (the only runtime write in the hook).","crates/ironclaw_webui/frontend/src/layout/gateway-layout.tsx:3,34: imports and calls useInterfaceTheme() in GatewayLayout; theme/toggleTheme passed to Sidebar (line 135) and setTheme/theme to an outlet context (lines 179-180).","crates/ironclaw_webui/frontend/src/app/app.tsx: also references GatewayLayout (router layout); no theme logic found there.","crates/ironclaw_webui/frontend/src/styles/app.css:83 and :126: :root[data-theme=\"dark\"] and :root[data-theme=\"light\"] selectors that consume the attribute (color-scheme and --v2-* variables).","crates/ironclaw_webui/frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts:4: type declaration for __IRONCLAW_INITIAL_THEME__.","Navigation/reset risk: the hook's state lives in GatewayLayout, so a full page load re-runs index.html and getInitialTheme; a full reload is safe because localStorage is re-read. No code in src/ writes data-theme outside the hook. Note that the hook prefers window.__IRONCLAW_INITIAL_THEME__ over the live data-theme attribute, so a test that changes the DOM attribute without localStorage will see state diverge until the next reload.","tests/e2e/scenarios/test_reborn_webui_v2_smoke.py:443-451: test seeds localStorage 'light' and sets dataset.theme, reloads, and asserts data-theme == 'light'.","tests/e2e/scenarios/test_reborn_webui_v2_smoke.py:503-507, 549-577: test sets dataset.theme directly via evaluate and checks localStorage 'ironclaw:v2-theme' after toggling appearance options, with reload() and goto() steps that re-verify persistence.","Duplicate build artifacts: target/debug/build/ironclaw_webui-*/out/webui-v2-frontend-dist/index.html:29-39 is a copy of the frontend index.html (generated output, not source)."],"confidence":0.8}

content.text: Prefer the live DOM attribute, and keep the global in sync.
